properties.name: Danube Bulgars
properties.linkNote: The state founded on the Danube in 681, which the Codex covers as the First Bulgarian Empire. The separate 'Bulgars' polygon at 600 is Old Great Bulgaria, a different polity, and is deliberately not linked here.

properties.name: Bulgars
properties.gapNote: Old Great Bulgaria, which is not the First Bulgarian Empire the Codex covers. Deliberately unlinked.

properties.name: Khazars
properties.gapNote: No article for the Khazar Khaganate.

properties.name: Visigothic Kingdom
properties.gapNote: No article for the Visigothic Kingdom, only for the Visigoths as a people.

properties.name: Eastern Roman Empire
properties.linkNote: The source's name for the state the Codex covers as the Byzantine Empire. Contemporaries called it Roman; 'Byzantine' is a later historians' label for the same polity.
